title: Interaction
description: A candidate or verified card interaction/combo/line. Lives in interactions/candidate/<id>.json until validated, then moves to interactions/verified/<id>.json. Only files in interactions/verified/ may be used as deterministic transitions in simulation (charter non-negotiable rule 1) - and per docs/VERIFICATION_LEVELS.md, only verification_level=ENGINE_EXACT_VERIFIED entries may be hardcoded as a fixed hop in a native (non-engine-driven) tracker; other verified tiers (RULES_VERIFIED, ENGINE_COMPONENT_VERIFIED, CONDITIONAL) may inform an engine-driven simulation but must not be hardcoded as if their exact transition were itself proven.

verification_level.description: Required (non-null) when status=verified; must be null otherwise. See docs/VERIFICATION_LEVELS.md for the full definition of each tier and what each may/may not be used for.

prerequisites.description: Required for status=verified per charter Level 4 exact-line validation checklist.

timing.description: e.g. 'main phase, sorcery speed', 'any time player has priority'.

loop_termination.description: Required detail if is_loop=true: what stops the loop and how the result is achieved.

deterministic.description: True only if the line has no dependency on opponent choices or randomness once prerequisites are met. Must be false for anything not yet Level-4-validated.

rules_citations.description: Comprehensive Rules section numbers and/or Oracle rulings cited.

exact_reproduction.description: true only if this engine run reproduced the interaction's own full stated transition (prerequisites through result) end-to-end - the ENGINE_EXACT_VERIFIED case. false if it reproduced a component or downstream consequence of the interaction instead - the ENGINE_COMPONENT_VERIFIED case. See docs/VERIFICATION_LEVELS.md.

coverage_backlog_ref.description: Backlog entry ID if this interaction is blocked on something.
